$description: The design tools the packages export to, what the exports rely on in each, where each tool publishes its changes, and how far those changes have been reviewed (agents/design-tools.md). The skill design-tools-watch reads it and moves `reviewed` forward after each review. A `reviewed` of null means never reviewed: the next review covers the last twelve months.

figma.name: Figma
figma.label: figma
exports: @quantum-ds/tokens dist/figma/: variables to import (style-dictionary.config.mjs, format quantum/figma)
@quantum-ds/figma: the plugin drawing the components (packages/figma/, manifest api 1.0.0, documentAccess dynamic-page)
reliesOn: Variables: collections, modes (one per collection on the Starter plan, formerly Free), scopes, web code syntax, aliases between collections, hiddenFromPublishing
Variable types COLOR, FLOAT and STRING; EASING and TIMING exist since plugin API 1.133 but are not used yet; no type for a shadow

Binding variables to fields: padding, gap, corner radius, stroke weight (all sides and per side), width and height, min size, opacity (a FLOAT read as 0-100), typography members; fill and stroke colors through setBoundVariableForPaint
A number variable bound to a line height is read as pixels: a unitless line height is set as a percentage instead
No expression in a binding: a value computed from tokens (the focus ring's radius) is set without a variable
Component sets with VARIANT, TEXT and BOOLEAN properties, instances

Auto layout (sizing, alignment, baseline) with inside strokes included in layout, as the web's border-box; focus rings as absolutely positioned frames with an outside stroke; the layout version a new frame gets (updated auto layout since July 2026)
Font loading by family and style (the icon font, Material Symbols Outlined, is not among Figma's fonts); no variable binds a font's variation axes
The plugin window (figma.showUI, theme colors, networkAccess)
Figma's own variable import of dist/figma/: DTCG JSON, one file per mode, color objects, number, fontFamily and string values, aliases written without $type

sources.covers: Product releases of the last six months
Plugin API changes (feed: rss.xml under the same path)
Plugin API typings, one version per API change (no GitHub releases)

penpot.name: Penpot
penpot.label: penpot
exports: @quantum-ds/tokens dist/penpot/tokens.json: token sets and themes for the Tokens panel import (format quantum/penpot)
@quantum-ds/penpot: the plugin drawing the components and writing the tokens (packages/penpot/, manifest version 2)
reliesOn: The Tokens panel import: sets, themes, token types (spacing, sizing, borderRadius, borderWidth, fontSizes, number, opacity, typography…), references, $description, $metadata (tokenSetOrder, activeThemes, activeSets) and $themes
A line height alone is a number token: lineHeights is taken only inside a typography token, where a lineHeight needs a fontSize

The plugin tokens API on the file's own tokens (not a connected library's): addToken (number and opacity values as text, font weights as numbers), token sets, themes and their activation, applyToken and applyToShapes, a token's property names (fontFamilies since 2.19, fontFamily before)
Applying a token toggles it, off every shape of the call when one already has it
Each token application resolves every token of the active sets (one Style Dictionary build): applications are batched
Components with variants: combining boards as variants, variant properties set through the main's name (names and values up to 60 characters)
Flex layout: padding, gap, sizing, alignment (no baseline), min size honoured inside a layout only
Strokes on every side only (no per-side stroke), no partial ellipse, textDecoration takes 'none' and not null
Writes on the active page only (openPage first), penpot.waitForLayoutUpdate, a clone keeping its values and applied tokens, shared plugin data marking a drawn component
Fonts by family name from Penpot's catalog and the team's fonts
The plugin manifest version 2 and its window (theme in the URL hash, messages to the parent window)

sources.covers: The design tokens format and its import

tokens-studio.name: Tokens Studio
tokens-studio.label: tokens-studio
exports: @quantum-ds/tokens dist/tokens_studio/: one set per top-level group, tokens.json wrapped as the set `tokens`, tokens-dark.json (format quantum/tokens-studio; not packaged yet)
reliesOn: Its own token types: color, dimension, spacing, sizing, borderRadius, borderWidth, fontSizes, lineHeights, letterSpacing, fontFamilies, fontWeights, typography, boxShadow, opacity, number; it maps some DTCG type names to them (fontFamily, fontWeight, shadow), not dimension
Colors as rgba(), lengths as px strings, font weights as JSON numbers, references in braces: it does not read DTCG color or dimension objects in token files
No type for a duration or an easing before 2.12.1: those tokens are left out
A file with $value is read in its DTCG mode ($type/$value), the default since 2.11.0
Typography composite members as strings
A boxShadow layer as { x, y, blur, spread, color, type }, not the DTCG shadow shape (no shadow token is exported today)

sources.covers: Token types and formats (lags behind the releases: the source code is the reference)

dtcg.name: Design Tokens Format Module (DTCG)
exports: The token sources (packages/tokens/src/) and dist/dtcg/ with its resolver (quantum.resolver.json): the format every design tool export starts from
reliesOn: Format 2025.10 value shapes: color objects (colorSpace, components, alpha, hex), dimension objects in px or rem, duration in ms or s, cubicBezier, number, fontFamily, fontWeight (1-1000 or keywords)
Composites: typography (unitless lineHeight), shadow, border
References in braces, $type inherited from groups, $description, $extensions; the sources use none of $root, $extends, $deprecated or $ref, which the token library does not read
Resolver 2025.10: version 2025.10, sets, modifiers with contexts and a default, resolutionOrder as $ref JSON Pointers
Which version of the format each design tool reads
